setup.title: Store setup
setup.intro: Stripe subscriptions and one-time checkout use these settings. Secrets are stored encrypted and are never shown again.
setup.boundary: Store checkout charges cards and provisions MCP access. SaaS records subscriptions locally without charging. Membership grants access without payment. Connections (MCP/AI/S3) are separate from Stripe.
setup.ready: Minimum configuration is in place for provisioning sales.
setup.not_ready: Complete the steps below before expecting checkout to work end-to-end.
setup.step_stripe_help: Add sk_test_ or sk_live_ in Store settings or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. Saving here overrides the environment.
setup.step_webhook_help: Create an endpoint in the Stripe Dashboard pointing at the URL below, then paste whsec_… in Store settings.
setup.step_server_help: Add HTTPS URL, client ID and HMAC secret, then use Test connection on the server page.
setup.step_product_help: Create a product with plan code, billing server, price and Active checked—or duplicate the inactive Examples (provisioning, service, digital) in Products.
setup.step_verify_help: Use Stripe test mode on this deploy, complete checkout, confirm the order is paid and provisioning runs. Health checks do not replace a test payment.

settings.confirm_live: I understand: switching to live uses the live key and real customer payments.
settings.mode_help: Switching to live is checked on the server before anything is saved: a live key that is not test-prefixed, a live webhook secret, and a read-only Stripe call that reports a live key. Switching to test needs no confirmation. Orders keep the mode that created them.
settings.auth_mismatch: Stripe reports the other mode for this key
settings.auth_unverified: not verified: a stored key proves nothing until Verify key succeeds
settings.delivery_unverified: not verified: no signed event from Stripe has reached this endpoint (the local test event does not count)
settings.send_test_event_help: Signs a local event with the test webhook secret and processes it. It proves the secret and the handler, not that Stripe can reach this site.
flash.mode_test: Switched to test mode. Checkout now uses the test key; orders created from now on are marked test.
flash.mode_live: Switched to live mode after verifying the live key. Real payments are now accepted.
flash.verify_ok: Key authenticated with Stripe. Webhook delivery is a separate check.
error.verify_no_key: No key is stored for that mode.
error.verify_mismatch: Stripe answered, but this key belongs to the other mode.
error.verify_failed: Stripe rejected the key or could not be reached. Nothing was changed.
error.mode_confirm: Tick the confirmation to switch to live mode.
error.mode_live_key_missing: No live secret key: store one (or STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) before switching to live.
error.mode_live_key_test: The live slot holds a test key: live mode was not enabled.
error.mode_live_webhook_missing: No live webhook secret: store one before switching to live.
error.mode_live_verify_failed: Stripe did not accept the live key, so live mode was not enabled.
error.mode_test_key_live: The test slot holds a live key: that would take real payments in test mode.
health.auth_mismatch: the stored key belongs to the other mode
error.test_slot_live_key: The test secret key field only takes a test key (sk_test_…): a live key here would take real payments in test mode. Nothing was saved.
error.live_slot_test_key: The Stripe secret key field only takes a live key (sk_live_…): put test keys in the test secret key field. Nothing was saved.
settings.auth_stale: last check is older than a day: verify again
health.auth_stale: key check is %s old; verify again
